method_disagreement.finding: The old age-decrease proxy systematically undercounts always-fresh pilot rows. Phase-change-or-age-decrease is a lower bound because quantized phase values can repeat. Reconstructed update instants and the age-versus-row-interval test independently place both pilots near 10 Hz.
method_disagreement.selection_reason: It directly reconstructs the source-update instant from two recorded fields and detects an advancing update even when age does not decrease and the phase value repeats.

old_phase_age_decrease_proxy.definition: count rows where phase_age_ms[i] < phase_age_ms[i-1]; divide by timestamp span
old_phase_age_decrease_proxy.role: systematically undercounts always-low age after genuinely new updates

phase_age_less_than_previous_row_interva.definition: count rows where phase_age_ms[i] < ts[i]-ts[i-1]; divide by timestamp span
phase_age_less_than_previous_row_interva.role: independent confirmation that the stored phase update is newer than the previous telemetry emission

phase_value_change_or_age_decrease.definition: count rows where breath_phase changes or phase_age_ms decreases; divide by timestamp span
phase_value_change_or_age_decrease.role: independent evidence lower bound; repeated quantized phase values can hide genuine updates

reconstructed_update_instant_advances.definition: reconstruct update_ms[i]=ts_monotonic_ms[i]-phase_age_ms[i]; count rows where update_ms[i] > update_ms[i-1]; divide by timestamp span
reconstructed_update_instant_advances.role: selected estimator because it directly tests whether the stored source-update instant advances and does not depend on phase-value changes or age decreases

regression_guards.low_age_definition: max(phase_age_ms) < 2 * median telemetry interval; regression diagnostic only
regression_guards.materially_below_row_cadence_definition: fresh cadence < 0.95 * row cadence; regression diagnostic only
